# Architecture — story-loom

*Generated by planner (story 9.5). The canonical source of file paths and conventions for all epics & stories. Every story's `**Files to create/modify:**` paths are drawn from §3 — stories never invent paths.*

---

## 1. Stack

| Layer | Choice | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Framework | **Next.js 16** (App Router, `src/`, TypeScript) | React 19; RSC by default |
| UI | **Tailwind CSS** + **shadcn/ui** (Radix primitives) | utilities + shadcn only; no bespoke CSS files |
| Data | **Prisma ORM** + **PostgreSQL** (Neon serverless) | single connection via singleton |
| AI | **Vercel AI SDK** + **Anthropic Claude** | story generation via Server Action |
| Mutations/reads | **Server Actions** (`src/app/actions.ts`) | no REST route handlers |
| Validation | **Zod** (`src/lib/validation.ts`) | validate before any DB write or AI call |
| Tests | **Vitest** + **React Testing Library**, co-located `*.test.tsx` | scaffolded by greenfield `--with-vitest` |
| CI/CD | **GitHub Actions** (lint + build + test) → **Vercel** | scaffolded by `--with-actions` |
| Dates | **date-fns + date-fns-tz** | ALL date logic via these libs; format/compute in UTC (`formatInTimeZone(d,'UTC',…)`); NEVER hand-roll date math |
| Auth | **None** — single-user app | explicit Brief decision; no session/user model |

## 2. Data model — `prisma/schema.prisma`

Two entities. Source of truth for all persistence.

```prisma
datasource db {
  provider = "postgresql"
  url      = env("DATABASE_URL")
}

generator client {
  provider = "prisma-client-js"
}

model JournalEntry {
  id        String   @id @default(cuid())
  text      String
  createdAt DateTime @default(now())

  @@index([createdAt])
}

model WeeklyStory {
  id          String   @id @default(cuid())
  weekStart   DateTime // Monday of the ISO week (UTC midnight)
  story       String   // LLM-generated story text
  createdAt   DateTime @default(now())

  @@unique([weekStart])
  @@index([weekStart])
}
```

- `JournalEntry` — a free-text creative note; timestamp is server-assigned.
- `WeeklyStory` — one AI-generated story per ISO week, keyed by `weekStart` (Monday UTC midnight). The `@@unique` constraint makes "generate if not yet generated" idempotent.
- No `User` / relations — single-user MVP.

**The canonical path universe. Every story's `**Files to create/modify:**` paths are drawn from this table.**

| `src/components/WeekList.tsx` | server | List of past week links in history view |

| `src/components/ui/*` | ui | shadcn primitives (button, textarea, card, badge) — add as needed |

## 4. Conventions (the coder's house rules — applied every story)

- **Data access:** all reads/writes go through **Server Actions** in `src/app/actions.ts`. No `app/api/*` route handlers. Actions `import { db } from "@/lib/db"`.
- **Prisma client:** exactly one, via `src/lib/db.ts` using the `globalThis` singleton pattern (prevents dev hot-reload connection exhaustion).
- **Validation:** every action validates input with a Zod schema from `src/lib/validation.ts` and returns a typed `{ data, error }` result; never trust raw form input.
- **AI calls:** `generateWeeklyStory` uses the Vercel AI SDK `generateText` with `anthropic("claude-3-5-haiku-20241022")`. The week's entries are passed as a bullet list in the prompt. If the week has zero entries the action returns an error without calling the API.
- **Week arithmetic:** `src/lib/week.ts` is the single source of truth for week boundaries. `currentWeekStart()` returns the Monday (UTC midnight) of the current ISO week as a `Date`. All week keys stored in the DB are Mondays at UTC midnight.
- **Components:** Server Components by default; add `"use client"` only for interactivity (`EntryForm`, `WeeklyStoryPanel`). Lists that only render data stay server (`EntryList`, `WeekList`).
- **Styling:** shadcn/ui for primitives, Tailwind utilities for layout. No standalone `.css` files beyond the scaffold's `globals.css`.
- **Tests:** co-located `Foo.test.tsx` beside `Foo.tsx`; Vitest + RTL; component tests mock the actions/db, not hit Postgres. AI calls are mocked in tests.
- **Imports:** `@/*` alias (configured by scaffold) for everything under `src/`.

## 5. Data flow (per request)

```
EntryForm ("use client")
  ──createEntry(text)──▶ actions.ts ──Zod validate──▶ db (Prisma) ──▶ JournalEntry row

Home page (server)
  ──listEntriesForWeek(weekStart)──▶ actions.ts ──▶ db ──▶ EntryList renders reverse-chron

WeeklyStoryPanel ("use client")
  ──generateWeeklyStory(weekStart)──▶ actions.ts ──list entries──▶ Vercel AI SDK (Anthropic)
  ──▶ db upsert WeeklyStory ──▶ returns story text

History page (server)
  ──listWeeks()──▶ actions.ts ──▶ db GROUP BY weekStart ──▶ WeekList renders links

Per-week detail page (server)
  ──listEntriesForWeek + getStoryForWeek──▶ EntryList + WeeklyStoryPanel
```

## 6. How this decomposes into the DAG (orientation for epics & stories)

- **Epic 1 — Entry Capture:** schema+db+helpers → validation+actions+EntryForm → EntryList+home page wired
- **Epic 2 — Story Generation:** WeeklyStoryPanel + `generateWeeklyStory` action (depends on Epic 1 foundation)
- **Epic 3 — History:** history page + per-week detail + WeekList + `listWeeks` + `getStoryForWeek` (depends on Epic 1 + 2 data layer)
